verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair axis for an API-driven observability platform, so the story applies. However, the evidence pack never documents issuing least-privilege or scoped API keys for an agent. The only related item is Project-level RBAC Roles behind an enterprise license, which is an adjacent user-role control rather than credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
